functions.residue: RESIDUE SHAPE 34 0x28 ldr r3, [pc, #0x1c0] | rsb r1, r1, #0; 0x2c rsb r2, r2, #0 | ldr r2, [sp]; 0x30 ldr r5, [sp] | and r0, r0, r1, lsr #23
functions.description: Build and append bitfield record from script parameters
functions.notes: ~16 gate runs. Only diff: after rec.f0 bitfield insert, target uses r2 for mask, r5 as temp, g in r3 and validIds loaded before the store; ours uses r1 mask. Tried ids-before-store, direct globals, local copy of f0, colorsweep (stmtswap no gain). Best kept at 34 bytes.
